**Standard Job Description**
 WHAT WE'RE DOING
   

  

 At Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems, we are inspired by innovation and integrity. We believe that by applying the highest standards of business ethics and creative thinking, everything is within our reach – and yours as a Lockheed Martin employee. Lockheed Martin values your skills, training and education. Come and experience your future!
   

  

 THE WORK
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of analytics, digital transformation, and quality operations. You’ll shift the organization from reactive reporting to proactive, insight\-driven action. A core focus is delivering a newly improved quality analytics system over the finish line and beyond, while also building rapid\-turn analysis capabilities and long\-term digital tools for shop\-floor data, inspection optimization, and process variation control. This is a high\-impact individual contributor where your analytics directly enable faster, better quality decisions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Collect, process, and analyze quality data to develop immersive, actionable narratives that answer pressing business questions
   

  

 Apply proven statistical methods to mine, process, and summarize large datasets; translate insights into tangible actions that drive cost, schedule, and quality improvements
   

  

 Identify and integrate novel data sources to enrich analysis; apply mathematical and statistical methods to business and risk management problems
   

  

 Design, build, and maintain dashboards and visual reporting tools that make complex quality insights accessible to stakeholders
   

  

 Manage the quality assurance of data scraping, database queries, and stakeholder requests; triage and resolve data issues for timely resolution
   

  

 Produce and track key performance indicators (KPIs) that matter to Sikorsky’s quality and mission assurance goals
   

  

 Formulate functional and technical requirements from business problems; program\-manage key tasks and resources to deliver on cost and schedule
   

  

 Partner with subject\-matter experts and cross\-LM analytics professionals to accelerate the systems and sustain its evolution
   

  

 Develop tools and workflows for daily business rhythms reducing routine data requests are fulfilled in hours
   

  

 Lead inspection optimization and process variation analysis; design alerting and monitoring systems for real\-time process control
   

  

 Drive digital transformation of shop\-floor data, transitioning from paper\-based or inaccessible sources into structured, analyzable digital formats; develop new inspection methods and variation\-control frameworks
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Our customers are world\-wide and so is our reputation for creating original solutions with the latest technologies. Our products keep our customers safe and bring them home to their families at night.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 You thrive in a collaborative, multidisciplinary engineering environment and are committed to delivering best\-in\-class products and solutions.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or equivalent experience/combined education.
* 5\+ years hands\-on experience in data analytics, preferably within quality, manufacturing, or aerospace environments
* Knowledge of statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and data visualization tools (Python, R, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, or equivalents)
* Strong experience with data cleaning, mining, summarization, and database extraction; ensuring data quality and hygiene
* Ability to translate complex statistical findings into clear, business\-focused stories and recommendations
* Experience with process improvement methodologies (Six Sigma) and KPI development/tracking
* Program/project management experience—able to scope, plan, and deliver analytics initiatives on schedule and within scope


**Desired Skills**
* Background in a STEM discipline (e.g., engineering, computer science, physics, mathematics, or a related field).
* Direct experience with Sikorsky quality systems, inspection processes, or rotary\-wing manufacturing/maintenance environments
* Prior work on digital transformation of shop\-floor or paper\-based data streams
* Knowledge of inspection optimization, process variation control, or alerting/monitoring systems
